zh.title: 西雪梨國際機場宣布越捷航空將開航胡志明市與曼谷航線
zh.summary: 西雪梨國際機場迎越捷航空進駐；預計2027年開航胡志明市與曼谷
body: 西雪梨國際機場（WSI）宣布，越捷航空（Vietjet Air）將自2027年1月起開航往返越南胡志明市的定期客運航線。這項宣布標誌著該越南航空公司在該機場今年稍後正式啟用旅客營運前，正式進駐雪梨最新的國際航空樞紐 Gateway。
根據西雪梨國際機場發布的資訊，越捷航空於2027年1月起將以每週兩班的頻率營運胡志明市航線，並計劃於2027年3月進一步增加至每週三班。該航線將採用越捷航空配置377個座位的空中巴士（Airbus）A330廣體客機執飛。班機預計於當地時間上午10時抵達西雪梨國際機場，並於中午12時05分起飛返回胡志明市。
除胡志明市航線外，越捷航空旗下合資公司泰國越捷航空（Vietjet Thailand）亦計劃自2027年11月起開航西雪梨國際機場與泰國曼谷之間的航線，預計提供每週四班服務，目前該航線仍有待監管機構批准。胡志明市航線單程票價自299澳幣（約212美元）起，機票預售已於2026年8月10日展開。
胡志明市航線獲得新南威爾斯州政府透過「西雪梨國際機場起飛基金」（Western Sydney International Take-Off Fund）給予資金支持。澳洲聯邦基礎建設部長 Catherine King 表示，該航線為越捷航空在澳洲的第五個航點，目前機場航站樓的測試與最終準備工作正在積極進行中。
越捷航空執行長 Nguyen Thanh Son 表示，航空公司很高興成為首批進駐西雪梨國際機場的航司之一。西雪梨國際機場執行長 Simon Hickey 指出，西雪梨地區擁有超過7萬名越南裔居民，新航線將為當地社區提供直飛胡志明市及轉機至其他目的地的便利服務。

en.title: Western Sydney Airport Announces Vietjet Flights to Ho Chi Minh City and Bangkok
en.summary: Vietjet will launch services from Western Sydney to Ho Chi Minh City and Bangkok starting in 2027.
body: Western Sydney International Airport (WSI) has announced that Vietjet Air will begin operating passenger flights to Ho Chi Minh City starting in January 2027. The announcement marks the Vietnamese low-cost carrier's official entry into Sydney's newest international airport gateway ahead of its scheduled passenger opening later this year.

According to WSI, Vietjet will operate two weekly services to Ho Chi Minh City beginning in January 2027, before increasing frequency to three weekly flights by March 2027. The service will be operated using Vietjet's Airbus A330 aircraft, which seat 377 passengers. Scheduled flights will arrive at WSI at 10:00 local time and depart for Ho Chi Minh City at 12:05 local time.

Additionally, Vietjet's joint venture airline, Vietjet Thailand, plans to launch four weekly services between WSI and Bangkok starting in November 2027, subject to regulatory approval. One-way fares for the January Ho Chi Minh City flights start at AU$299 (US$212), with tickets officially going on sale on August 10, 2026, ahead of Lunar New Year travel in early February.

The new Ho Chi Minh City flights receive support from the New South Wales state government via the Western Sydney International Take-Off Fund, an initiative created to attract airlines and strengthen the state's international route network. Federal Minister for Infrastructure Catherine King stated that the route represents Vietjet's fifth Australian destination as testing and terminal preparations continue at WSI.

Vietjet CEO Nguyen Thanh Son noted that the airline is pleased to become one of the first operators at WSI as it expands its international network. WSI Chief Executive Officer Simon Hickey highlighted that Western Sydney is home to more than 70,000 Vietnamese residents, who will gain direct connections to Ho Chi Minh City and onward destinations.

zh.title: 華航7月合併營收創單月新高 長榮航寫歷史次高
zh.summary: 華航7月合併營收222.35億元創新高；長榮航合併營收224.54億元寫歷史次高
body: 中華航空公布2026年7月合併營收新台幣222.35億元，年增25.34%，為單月合併營收新高；其中客運收入126.35億元，年成長18.63%，貨運收入75.89億元，年增34.72%。華航表示，暑期旅遊旺季帶動東京、大阪、福岡、首爾及釜山等航點需求，中秋連假各航線預估訂位率可達8成以上。
貨運方面，華航指出7月受惠AI伺服器、半導體等高科技貨源及季節性生鮮水果出貨，高價包機和包艙需求踴躍。華航上半年合併營收亦創歷史新高，歸屬母公司淨利65.82億元，每股盈餘1.08元，淨利及EPS創歷年同期次高。
華航上半年貨運收入401.79億元，較去年同期增加80.07億元，成長24.89%，主因全球AI基礎設施建置需求帶動運量及運價同步提升。展望下半年，華航將持續交付A321neo、A350-900與787新機擴充運能。
長榮航空7月合併營收224.54億元，年增21.42%，創單月合併營收歷史次高；其中客運營收140.65億元，年增17.52%，創歷年同期新高；貨運營收60.34億元，年增32.76%。累計前7月客運營收951.60億元，合併營收1507.39億元，均創歷年同期新高。
長榮航表示，7月歐美長程航線平均載客率達8成5，東北亞航線平均載客率達9成，東南亞航線整體載客率接近9成，其中峇里島、清邁、峴港及吉隆坡等熱門航點載客率均逾9成5。長榮航並指出，自12月1日起將開闢桃園至印度德里直飛航線，每週5班，拓展南亞市場、串聯北美航網。
長榮航說明，7月貨運受歐美暑假影響空運需求略為放緩，加上歐盟新關稅政策實施，部分跨境電商貨量受到衝擊，歐洲進出口動能明顯轉弱，但AI供應鏈設備與伺服器等相關貨物艙位需求持續熱絡，支撐美洲及亞洲區間航班載貨量。

en.title: China Airlines posts record July revenue; EVA Air marks second-highest monthly total
en.summary: China Airlines July consolidated revenue TWD 22.235B, a monthly high; EVA Air TWD 22.454B, second-highest on record
body: China Airlines reported July 2026 consolidated revenue of TWD 22.235 billion, up 25.34% year-on-year, a single-month record. Passenger revenue reached TWD 12.635 billion, up 18.63%, while cargo revenue totaled TWD 7.589 billion, up 34.72%. The carrier said Tokyo, Osaka, Fukuoka, Seoul and Busan were the most popular destinations during the summer travel peak, with booking rates for the Mid-Autumn holiday expected to exceed 80% across routes.

On the cargo side, China Airlines said July benefited from AI server, semiconductor and other high-tech shipments as well as seasonal fresh fruit, with strong demand for high-value charter flights and blocked-space arrangements. First-half consolidated revenue also hit a record high, with net profit attributable to the parent of TWD 6.582 billion and EPS of TWD 1.08, both the second-highest for the comparable period.

First-half cargo revenue reached TWD 40.179 billion, up TWD 8.007 billion or 24.89% year-on-year, driven by global AI infrastructure build-out lifting both volume and rates. Looking ahead, China Airlines said it will continue taking delivery of new A321neo, A350-900 and 787 aircraft to expand capacity.

EVA Air reported July consolidated revenue of TWD 22.454 billion, up 21.42% year-on-year, the second-highest monthly consolidated revenue on record. Passenger revenue was TWD 14.065 billion, up 17.52% and a high for the comparable period, while cargo revenue reached TWD 6.034 billion, up 32.76%. Cumulative January-July passenger revenue of TWD 95.160 billion and consolidated revenue of TWD 150.739 billion both set highs for the period.

EVA Air said long-haul European and North American routes averaged an 85% load factor in July, Northeast Asia routes averaged 90%, and Southeast Asia routes approached 90%, with Bali, Chiang Mai, Da Nang and Kuala Lumpur exceeding 95%. EVA Air also noted that from December 1 it will launch nonstop Taoyuan-Delhi service, five flights per week, to expand the South Asian market and connect its North American network.

EVA Air said July cargo demand eased slightly due to the European and North American summer holiday period, and the EU's new tariff policy impacted some cross-border e-commerce volumes, weakening European import and export momentum. However, AI supply chain equipment and server-related cargo demand remained robust, supporting stable load factors on trans-Pacific and intra-Asia routes.

zh.title: 註冊號 HS-EAD 之 A321neo 觀測抵達桃園機場
zh.summary: AIQ231 呼號航班；HS-EAD 抵達 RCTP；營運者未識別
body: 本站監測系統觀測到一架註冊號為 HS-EAD 的航空器於臺灣桃園國際機場完成抵達。公開 ADS-B 觀測資料顯示，該機的確認抵達時間為 2026-08-10T10:51:46Z，抵達判定為 confirmed_arrival，確認依據為位於機場地理圍欄內且 alt_baro 為 ground。
該航空器的 ICAO hex 碼為 881424，呼號為 AIQ231，ICAO 機型代碼為 A21N，機型顯示名稱為 Airbus A321neo。營運者 ICAO 為 AIQ，但營運者 IATA、營運者名稱、營運者中文名稱及營運者所屬國家或地區均標示為未識別，因此無法從觀測資料本身確認執飛航空公司。
首次有效觀測時間為 2026-08-10T09:52:05Z，有效觀測筆數為 2。主要資料來源為 Airplanes.live，第二資料來源為 ADSB.lol，交叉確認狀態為 secondary_unavailable，表示第二資料來源在本次觀測期間無法提供交叉比對。
機場 ICAO 代碼為 RCTP，機場名稱為臺灣桃園國際機場。本次觀測事件 ID 為 fw-ffd2338f040252e2，資料類型為公開 ADS-B 觀測。
統計說明指出，系統觀測歷史累積中，尚無可比較的長期統計。本站系統目前無法就相同組合提供長期比對基準，因此無法判定此組合在觀測紀錄中的出現頻率。
由於營運者身分未識別且第二資料來源交叉確認狀態為 secondary_unavailable，本則觀測僅記錄航空器抵達事實，不對航班性質、航線、目的或營運者背景作任何推論。

en.title: Airbus A321neo HS-EAD Observed Arriving at Taoyuan International Airport
en.summary: AIQ231 callsign; HS-EAD arrived at RCTP; operator unidentified
body: The site's monitoring system observed an aircraft with registration HS-EAD completing an arrival at Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport. Public ADS-B observation data shows the confirmed arrival time as 2026-08-10T10:51:46Z, with the arrival determination marked as confirmed_arrival, based on the aircraft being within the airport geofence and alt_baro indicating ground.

The aircraft's ICAO hex code is 881424, callsign is AIQ231, ICAO aircraft type code is A21N, and the model display name is Airbus A321neo. The operator ICAO is AIQ, but operator IATA, operator name, operator Chinese name, and operator country or region are all marked as unidentified, making it impossible to confirm the operating airline from the observation data alone.

The first valid observation time was 2026-08-10T09:52:05Z, with a total of 2 valid observation records. The primary data source is Airplanes.live, the secondary data source is ADSB.lol, and the cross-confirmation status is secondary_unavailable, indicating the secondary source could not provide cross-verification during this observation period.
The airport ICAO code is RCTP, and the airport name is Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport. The observation event ID is fw-ffd2338f040252e2, and the data type is public ADS-B observation.

The statistical note indicates that the system's observation history is still accumulating, with no comparable long-term statistics available. The site's system currently cannot provide a long-term comparison baseline for the same combination, so the frequency of this combination in observation records cannot be determined.

Because the operator identity is unidentified and the secondary data source cross-confirmation status is secondary_unavailable, this observation only records the fact of the aircraft's arrival. No inference is made regarding the nature of the flight, route, purpose, or operator background.
